title: Executable small bias generator
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and positive $\ell$, let a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ be given, and choose seed vectors $r,s\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^\ell$. The generator returns a vector $x\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$ whose $i$th coordinate is the binary dot product of $s$ with the coordinate vector representing $r^{i+1}$ modulo the certified irreducible polynomial.
hypotheses_covered: a certified binary field implementation of degree $\ell$ is given
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the encoding of field elements as binary vectors or the precise meaning of modular exponentiation.
